management_volatilization_provenance.justification: Frvo partitions newly added management NH4 and is reported through the same addition-event variables; unchanged application to pre-existing continuation state would alter provenance and state semantics.

soil_transformation_domain.justification: The audited nitrification/transformation machinery is bound to soil-layer environmental states and does not define a process on the surface nonaqueous continuation owner.

soil_sorption_ownership.justification: NH4 sorption parameters and adsorbed-state initialization are soil-layer owned; direct continuation-to-sorption assignment would require an explicit new cross-compartment and cross-phase transfer.

top_reservoir_semantic_identity.justification: Conhtop/Rsconhtop is an upper-boundary input reservoir with its own Hetop and flux-driven release semantics, not an interchangeable residual ponding owner.

aqueous_transport_as_continuation_owner.justification: Aqueous concentration transport requires a representable aqueous owner; it can act after a separately qualified transfer but cannot itself carry finite continuation mass through zero aqueous storage.

new_or_adapted_process_law.justification: SQ04 qualifies only the negative unchanged-reuse audit and does not select, adapt or parameterize a future process law.

historical_behavior.justification: Historical behavior remains UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2 and is outside this source-semantic audit.

split_run_or_restart_evidence.justification: SQ04 is a source-bound semantic reuse audit with no implementation or changed restart state; restart behavior of a future adapted process must be qualified in that later workunit.
